# Direct `codex sandbox` runs on the Linux cluster instance (codex-cli 0.163.0, kernel 6.8, Apptainer container, no
# system bwrap), in a throwaway directory under /work/probe/sbx. No --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox.

$ codex sandbox -- sh -c "git --version; echo x > a.txt"
bwrap: Can't bind mount /oldroot/ on /newroot/: Unable to mount source on destination: Invalid argument
EXIT=1

$ codex sandbox -c features.use_legacy_landlock=true -- sh -c "git --version; echo x > a.txt; node -e ..."
thread 'main' (2897693) panicked at linux-sandbox/src/linux_run_main.rs:416:9:
filesystem-restricted execution requires bubblewrap to isolate app-server sockets
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
EXIT=101

# Afterwards: the directory was empty (no a.txt) and /tmp had no ro-probe-* entry.
# `codex features list`: use_legacy_landlock deprecated false; use_linux_sandbox_bwrap removed false.
# Root filesystem: overlay (lowerdir=/var/lib/apptainer/mnt/session/...), process uid 0, NoNewPrivs 1.
